honesty_banner: THIS IS A MODEL, NOT A BACKTEST ON REAL QUOTES. We hold no historical options quotes; every premium is Black-Scholes off the underlying tape with an ASSUMED volatility. IV is the dominant error source and the error concentrates exactly where 0DTE trades live (minutes to expiry, breakout-day IV spikes). Read the band across anchors, never a single number. The Alpaca options paper forward test (real quotes, real fills) is the arbiter.
